Coil.notes: Bounded pulse, PWM hold, paired windings or continuous-duty operation. Default is a directly controlled GPIO driver; board-managed hold requires a dedicated driver.

settings.label: Coil operation
settings.help: Disabled by default. Enabling permits this coil to operate only when the ESP is also armed.

settings.label: Operating mode
settings.help: Match your coil AND output driver. Hold winding is a secondary output controlled only through its paired power pin. Board-managed hold is not supported by Default.

settings.label: Initial / default pulse (ms)
settings.help: Normal pulse length, bounded by the hard pulse limit. Used before PWM or separate-winding hold. A PULSE rule may specify a different duration within the limit.

settings.label: Hard pulse limit (ms)
settings.help: Maximum permitted full-power kick or explicit PULSE command. Does not define the hold duration. Default: 20 ms.

settings.label: Minimum off-time (ms)
settings.help: Conservative starting cooldown: 1,000 ms. Must be at least the maximum on-time. An early reactivation trips a fault; use a longer cooldown for lower duty cycles.

settings.label: Maximum hold / activation (ms)
settings.help: Finite safety timeout for hold or continuous operation. Expiry turns the whole assembly off and latches a fault. A paired assembly cannot exceed its hold winding limit.

settings.label: PWM hold duty (%)
settings.help: PWM mode only. No assumed safe hold power: select 5–95% in 5% increments before enabling. This is switching duty, not a measured current or power percentage.

settings.label: PWM frequency (Hz)
settings.help: PWM mode only. Match the external output driver. Default firmware supports these frequencies with a 100 µs interrupt tick.

settings.label: Linked hold-winding pin
settings.help: Separate-winding mode only. Select another pin configured as Coil / Hold winding. Its PIN Safe and limits remain independent.

RGB Strip.notes: Addressable LEDs on ESP. Default uses FastLED; NeoPixel is available as an alternative backend.

settings.label: I2C Address
settings.help: MMA8452 address (typically 0x1c or 0x1d).

settings.label: Tilt Sensitivity (mg)
settings.help: Higher values require a stronger jolt to emit TILT_NUDGE.

settings.label: Lift Angle (deg)
settings.help: Emit TILT_LIFTED when table angle exceeds this value.

settings.label: Lift Hysteresis (deg)
settings.help: Prevents TILT_LIFTED state chatter near the threshold.

settings.label: Mount Direction
settings.help: Use Inverted when the module is mounted upside down.

settings.label: Sample Interval (ms)
settings.help: Polling interval for accelerometer reads.

settings.label: Tilt Cooldown (ms)
settings.help: Minimum time between TILT_NUDGE events.

settings.label: I2C Address
settings.help: Display backpack I2C address (commonly 0x27 or 0x3f).

settings.label: Columns
settings.help: Visible characters per line (typically 16).

settings.label: Rows
settings.help: Number of display lines (typically 2).

settings.label: Auto Off (seconds)
settings.help: Backlight auto-off timeout. Set 0 or leave empty to keep the display always on.
